title: The replayed robocopy article's DOC facts are anchored
goal: Every DOC fact of kb/public/windows/robocopy.md (52, replayed from benchmark instance 3 without factdiff.py anchor --file) has a row in kb/public/_anchors.csv, so packs print no [unanchored] for it and a refresh sees source drift. Found by the SP-bhzxxhub review (S3).

run: import subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','robocopy /MIR mirror exit codes retries'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True);n=sum('unanchored' in l and 'robocopy.md' in l for l in p.stdout.splitlines());print('robocopy unanchored lines',n);sys.exit(1 if n else 0)
